name: What does the kitchen door frame repair process involve?

mainEntity.name: What does the kitchen door frame repair process involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen door frame repair begins with an evaluation of the jamb, hinges, and surrounding wall framing to pinpoint why the failure occurred. Technicians check the jamb for level and plumb, inspect for hidden moisture, and test door swing clearance. Next, technicians remove compromised trim or rotted wood sections. They install fresh wood Dutchman patches, reinforce hinge pockets with heavy-duty fasteners into structural studs, and adjust the strike plate. Finally, the frame is sanded, sealed against kitchen humidity, and re-aligned with the door slab.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspecting alignment and rot, removing damaged wood, splicing in sound material or reinforcing hinges, realigning the strike plate, and sealing against humidity.
